en: TWO-DAY STEP: the 27 Sep scheduled run never fired, so there is no 27 Sep day file and every comparison in this report is 26 Sep -> 28 Sep. Nothing has been interpolated for the missing day.

GSC CLICKS BROKE A FOUR-SCAN FREEZE AND FELL: 34 -> 31. The window slid two days - 27 Aug (5 clicks) and 28 Aug (1) dropped out while 24 Sep (2) and 25 Sep (1) came in, which is the whole of the fall.
IMPRESSIONS ROSE 1,013 -> 1,039 while CTR fell 3.4 -> 3.0 pct. Average position IMPROVED AGAIN, 28.0 -> 26.6, a third consecutive large gain that has still bought zero non-brand clicks.

BRAND DEPENDENCE FELL FOR THE WRONG REASON: brand clicks 27 -> 23 (79.4 -> 74.2 pct of all clicks). The share dropped because the brand queries themselves lost clicks - dx living 13 -> 12 and dxliving 12 -> 9 - not because commercial queries gained any.
EVERY COMMERCIAL NON-BRAND QUERY IS STILL AT ZERO CLICKS for the whole series: 52 zero-click non-brand queries this scan. The only non-brand click in the window remains the single 'i want 3 months'.

THE ONE REAL RANKING GAIN: '3d renders for builders melbourne' improved 18.8 -> 17.4 on rising impressions (21 -> 24) and is the closest non-brand query to page one. '3d renders for real estate melbourne' holds 15.3, still the best non-brand position.

FOUR TRACKED QUERIES DID NOT MOVE AT ALL on either position or impressions: 3d rendering melbourne (83.7, fifth read), 3d renders melbourne (57.7, eighth read), 3d renders for developers melbourne (55.1) and 3d interior renders melbourne (76.1). '3d rendering services melbourne' is absent for a twelfth day.

GSC PAGE INDEXING IS STALE FOR A SEVENTH DAY - the build is still dated 21 Sep, so indexed 83 / not-indexed 148 and all eight reasons are a 21 Sep view, not a 28 Sep one. Google has also not re-read the sitemap since 21 Sep; it still shows 116 discovered against 119 live URLs.

CORE WEB VITALS AND HTTPS BOTH REBUILT (23 -> 26 Sep and 17 -> 20 Sep) with no change in verdict: CWV still returns 'not enough usage data' for both mobile and desktop, and HTTPS is clean at 0 non-HTTPS URLs.
GA4 SESSIONS EASED 558 -> 552 and events 2,617 -> 2,583, but USERS ROSE 387 -> 392 with new users 362 -> 368. Engagement rate slipped 34.59 -> 33.88 pct.

THE NINE-WEEK ENGAGEMENT SLIDE BROKE. Week over week, engagement rate ROSE 26.74 -> 32.19 pct and average engagement time went from SIX SECONDS to 1m 12s. All three key events sit in the most recent week against zero in the prior week - but sessions fell 172 -> 146 at the same time, so this is a smaller, better-engaged audience rather than growth.

ORGANIC SEARCH REMAINS THE ONLY QUALITY CHANNEL: 133 sessions at 60.9 pct engagement and 1m 40s. Organic Social is 156 sessions - 28 pct of all traffic - at 23.08 pct and THREE SECONDS, and Facebook still arrives split across five separate source rows totalling 148 sessions.

THE SPAM BACKLINK INFLUX RE-ACCELERATED TEN-FOLD: referring domains 665 -> 709 and backlinks 701 -> 745, +44 each across two days (+22/day against the +2/day that had held all week). All-time counts moved by the same +44, so these are genuinely new links, and the followed share fell again to 42.3 pct of domains and 41.1 pct of links.

AI CITATIONS ROSE AND THE CITED-PAGES TILE FINALLY MOVED: AI responses 14 -> 17 and cited pages 9 -> 11, driven by Copilot (7 -> 9 responses) and ChatGPT (6 -> 7). AI Overviews, AI Mode and Gemini stay at zero. The AI visibility score is still 30/100 for a twentieth scan because 11 of 95 articles rounds to 1/10 on citation surface.

THE ARTICLE TEMPLATE DROPPED A SITE-WIDE PROMOTED LINK. Exactly 94 of the 95 articles each lost exactly one internal link (2,802 -> 2,708; average per page 23.7 -> 22.9) while words, schema and images were byte-identical everywhere - a template change, not a content change.

THE REMOVED LINK IS IDENTIFIABLE: the single article that did NOT lose a link is /articles/bim-3d-from-design-to-site-in-2026, because a page never links to itself. The featured-article block now promotes THREE articles instead of four; that article fell from 94 template inbound links to 8 sibling links plus the hub, so it is neither orphaned nor hub-only.

ORPHANS AND HUB-ONLY ARTICLES BOTH STAY AT ZERO despite that change, and the hub is byte-identical at 279,515 bytes with all 95 articles listed. FAQPage coverage holds at 82 of 95 articles (86.3 pct) with the same 13 still missing.

THE /ARTICLES OVERLAY IS ON DAY 32 AND UNCHANGED: one fixed full-viewport div at z-index 99999, and elementFromPoint at the viewport centre still returns BODY rather than an article link. It blocks human readers, not crawlers, and is the largest remaining UX defect on the site.

SPEED IMPROVED AGAIN: the ceiling fell 738 -> 617 ms and all 118 pages are under one second for a fifth consecutive crawl (mean 337 -> 334 ms, median 271 -> 268 ms). The slowest page is still the homepage. Nothing was published on any social channel for three days.
